description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers of a model, with the x-axis labeled “Layer” ranging from approximately 0 to 22 on a linear scale and the y-axis labeled “Sparsity Ratio” ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 on a linear scale. The plot contains three distinct lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003”; an orange dotted line with triangular markers representing the “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126”; and a green dashed line with square markers representing the “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080”. The blue line starts near 0.0 and increases steadily to approximately 0.4 near layer 22. The orange line begins near 0.8, drops sharply to about 0.2 by layer 5, then fluctuates slightly before leveling off near 0.25 by layer 22. The green line starts near 0.8, declines more gradually to about 0.2 by layer 5, then rises slightly to approximately 0.35 by layer 22.
